description: planStatusViewCommand golden vectors: randomByte returns env.randomBytes in order, repeating, starting fresh for each case.

cases.name: snooze-only-this
cases.description: Later writes the wake-up time and clears an explicit settle.

cases.name: snooze-opened-tree
cases.description: Including opened sub-conversations reaches every descendant, also ones the list does not show.

cases.name: snooze-in-the-past-is-refused
cases.description: A wake-up time at or before now plans nothing.

cases.name: snooze-read-only-is-refused
cases.description: A target without management permission refuses the whole command.

cases.name: settle-tree-tolerates-clock-skew
cases.description: settledAt is max(now, lastMessageAt) per target, and clears snoozedUntil.

cases.name: move-to-focus-only-this
cases.description: Move to Focus clears snooze and settle and records focusRestoredAt.

cases.name: pin-goes-to-top-of-default-section
cases.description: A newly pinned row gets a key above the default section; other sections do not count.

cases.name: unpin-keeps-order-key
cases.description: Unpinning clears the section and keeps orderKey for Focus.

cases.name: move-in-focus-materializes-expired-snoozes
cases.description: Reordering Focus first keys the woken rows at the top, clearing their snooze and keeping focusRestoredAt, then keys unkeyed rows above the drop and the moved row.

cases.name: move-in-focus-to-end
cases.description: beforeId null lands after the last row.

cases.name: move-in-focus-stale-before-id
cases.description: A beforeId that is not a Focus row resolves to the end.

cases.name: move-later-row-into-focus-restores-opened
cases.description: Dropping a Later row into Focus restores it and its opened sub-conversations; only the dropped row gets a key.

cases.name: move-pinned-row-into-focus-unpins
cases.description: A pinned row dropped into Focus leaves the Pinned area at the drop slot.

cases.name: move-woken-row-keeps-its-wake-up
cases.description: Dragging a woken row places it by key and records focusRestoredAt at its wake-up; its expired snoozedUntil stays, so it remains unread.

cases.name: later-reorder-keeps-a-placed-woken-row
cases.description: A woken row placed by an earlier reorder no longer floats, so a later reorder leaves it where it is and writes nothing to it.

cases.name: pinned-woken-row-dropped-into-focus-keeps-its-wake-up
cases.description: A pinned row with an expired snooze dropped into Focus is unpinned and placed without clearing the snooze, so it stays unread.

cases.name: drop-restores-opened-child-keeping-its-wake-up
cases.description: A Later row dropped into Focus restores its opened sub-conversations; a woken child keeps its expired snooze, so it stays unread, while a future snooze is cleared.

cases.name: move-to-focus-tree-keeps-woken-child-wake-up
cases.description: Move to Focus with its opened sub-conversations clears a future snooze and settle state but keeps an expired snooze on a woken child.

cases.name: move-in-focus-over-read-only-unkeyed-row-is-refused
cases.description: A drop below a row without a key that the member cannot manage would have to write that row, so the move plans nothing.

cases.name: move-in-focus-leaves-read-only-woken-row-unkeyed
cases.description: A woken row the member cannot manage keeps floating at the top without a key; the move still lands.

cases.name: move-into-section-keys-unkeyed-rows-above
cases.description: Dropping below rows without keys gives those above the drop keys first, in their current order.

cases.name: move-unpinned-row-into-section-pins-it
cases.description: A Focus row dropped into a pin section is pinned at that slot.

cases.name: move-to-section-top
cases.description: "Move to section" lands at the top of that section.

cases.name: create-section-after-the-last
cases.description: A new section goes after every existing one; the name is trimmed.

cases.name: create-section-blank-name-is-refused
cases.description: A section the catalog would drop is never written.

cases.name: rename-section
cases.description: Rename rewrites the whole row with the same key.

cases.name: move-section-down
cases.description: Move down places the section after its next neighbor.

cases.name: delete-section
cases.description: Deleting a section deletes its row; its conversations fall back on read.

cases.name: section-management-read-only-is-refused
cases.description: A read-only member cannot change sections.

cases.name: touch-on-send-clears-status
cases.description: Sending clears snoozedUntil and settledAt that are set, and nothing else.

cases.name: touch-on-send-without-status
cases.description: Sending in a Focus row plans nothing.

cases.name: new-session-goes-to-top-of-focus
cases.description: A new top-level conversation gets a key below every existing key, pinned rows included.

cases.name: new-opened-session-gets-no-key
cases.description: A conversation opened by another one renders nested and gets no key.
